rules.title: Least-privilege IAM
rules.text: Grant least-privilege IAM policies scoped to specific resources and actions.

rules.title: Roles, not access keys
rules.text: Use IAM roles and short-lived credentials; never create long-lived access keys for workloads.

rules.title: Encrypt by default
rules.text: Enable encryption at rest and block public access on S3 buckets.

rules.title: Tag resources
rules.text: Tag resources with owner, environment and cost center.

rules.title: Infrastructure as code only
rules.text: Create and change resources through infrastructure as code, not the console.

rules.title: Design for failure
rules.text: Run production workloads across multiple availability zones.
